# Detection parity evidence

`semantics.json` contains shared expected behavior, consumed by both
`DetectionSemanticsTests` (C#) and `shared_semantic_vectors` (Rust). It exercises
Boolean truth tables, typed scalar equality, field-name isolation, supported
string modifiers, load-time rejection and resource bounds. The expected Boolean
outcomes are explicit test data, not generated by either implementation.

`sigma.jsonl` was regenerated by .NET 10.0.402 `SigmaRuleLoader.LoadFile` and
`JsonSerializer.Serialize` for the ten shipped rules in the order listed by the
parity tests. Both runtimes check encoding and rule hashes against it.
`csharp-alerts.txt` was regenerated with C# `DetectionEngine.EvaluateJson`, fixed
clock `2026-10-17T01:02:03.4567+00:00`, and the existing semantic/cloud envelope
fixtures. Raw SSH samples are tested through the actual collector separately.

`odd.yml` is retained as a negative compatibility fixture: its duplicate
condition and nested selection are now rejected instead of silently flattened.
All inputs are synthetic; none of these artifacts is Sentinel query evidence.
